mem.ios.tagline: Keep track of birthdays, anniversaries, and the days that matter, so time is seen with tenderness.
mem.ios.desc: Gather birthdays, anniversaries, relationship milestones, holidays, and the days you care about in one quiet place. Count down to see how many days are left, and count up to hold on to how many have passed.
mem.ios.feat.0: Birthdays, anniversaries, holidays, and custom events
mem.ios.feat.1: Gregorian and Chinese lunar calendar dates
mem.ios.feat.3: Local reminders, Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets
mem.ios.guide.0.b: Open the app and tap add, then fill in the name, date, and any notes you want to keep. Choose a birthday, anniversary, holiday, or custom event as needed.
mem.ios.guide.1.b: Birthdays and anniversaries can use either the Gregorian or Chinese lunar calendar. Lunar entries automatically calculate the next matching date.
mem.ios.guide.2.b: Turn on local notifications for important days and choose to be reminded on the day or in advance. If notification permission is off, the app will point you to system settings to enable it.
mem.ios.guide.3.t: Turn on sync when you need it
mem.ios.guide.3.b: To sync across your iPhone, iPad, and Apple Watch, turn on sync while signed in to iCloud. Sync goes into your private CloudKit database, which the developer cannot read.
mem.hm.tagline: Record birthdays, anniversaries, and important days locally on your device.
mem.hm.desc: Anniversary Countdown for HarmonyOS is a fully local edition. No accounts, no connection, and no cloud sync: your data stays only in the app's sandbox on your device.
mem.hm.feat.0: Birthdays, anniversaries, holidays, and custom events
mem.hm.feat.1: Gregorian and Chinese lunar calendar dates
mem.hm.feat.4: Restore from trash or delete permanently
mem.hm.feat.5: No account, no ads, no network requests
mem.hm.guide.0.b: Go to the anniversaries page and tap create, then fill in the name, date, type, and notes. Choose a lunar calendar date if you need one.
mem.hm.guide.1.b: After you save, the app shows the next date based on the date and repeat rule. Lunar entries are converted according to the matching rule.
mem.hm.guide.2.b: Choose the reminder time and how many days ahead in each entry. When setting a reminder for the first time, please allow system notifications; turning the permission off only affects reminders, not your records or browsing.
mem.hm.guide.3.b: Deleted entries go to the trash first, where you can restore them or delete them permanently. Uninstalling the app removes its data on this device; since there is no cloud backup, it cannot be recovered after switching devices or uninstalling.
tt.desc: Footprints·TimeTrails is a privacy-first GPS route-tracking app. It automatically records your trips, runs, rides, hikes, and drives, vividly bringing your footprints to life on the map and lighting up the cities you've visited. No account sign-up, no ads or third-party tracking, and by default your route data is stored only on your device.
tt.feat.0: Automatically records your daily movement and mileage
tt.feat.1: Generates daily routes and activity summaries by local time
tt.feat.2: Revisit the places you've been with fog exploration
tt.feat.3: Recognizes activities like walking, cycling, and driving
tt.feat.4: Optionally import photos to keep memories along your routes
tt.feat.5: Optional private iCloud database backup and restore when you switch devices
tt.guide.0.b: For continuous background recording, allow "Always" location and "Precise Location" when the system prompts you. You can change this anytime in system settings.
tt.guide.1.b: Turn on recording the first time you open the app. You can always pause or resume within the app; you're in control.
tt.guide.2.b: Look back on each day's route, mileage, stops, and activity summary in the calendar or on the map.
tt.guide.3.t: Turn on backup when you need it
tt.guide.3.b: If you want to restore when switching devices or sync across multiple ones, turn on iCloud data backup yourself in settings; it's off by default.
trace.desc: 出行轨迹 TraceApp helps you record routes, mileage, speed, and pace, and stores your data in a local-first way. No account needed, with no third-party analytics or ad SDKs built in.
trace.feat.0: Record and display your travel routes
trace.feat.4: Store your history in the device sandbox
trace.guide.0.b: The first time you use the app, choose "While Using the App" or "Always" location permission as needed; you can change it anytime in system settings.
trace.guide.1.b: Start recording in the app, and your route, mileage, speed, and pace are saved to the current device.
trace.guide.2.b: View routes and statistics in your history, delete entries you don't need, or export them with the system share feature (where the app supports it).
trace.guide.3.t: Turn on iCloud when you need it
trace.guide.3.b: To sync across your own devices, turn on iCloud yourself in the system and the app; the developer never obtains your iCloud credentials or content.

tt.ui.headerSub: GPS track logging · Route replay · Privacy first
tt.ui.privBody: No account, no ads, no third-party tracking. Tracks are stored on your device by default; iCloud backup is entirely optional and goes only to your Apple CloudKit private database.
tt.ui.desc.start: Get started quickly, from granting location access to viewing your daily track.
tt.ui.desc.privacy: Learn how location, motion, and iCloud backup are handled in this app.
tt.ui.desc.terms: Please read the Terms of Use before using the app.
tt.ui.desc.support: Helping you record and revisit every journey with ease.
tt.ui.faq.0.q: Does Footprints·TimeTrails track my location all the time?
tt.ui.faq.0.a: You control the recording and can pause it anytime. System location is used only for on-device track logging, and data is stored only on the device by default.
tt.ui.faq.1.a: In Settings → Privacy & Security → Location Services, set Footprints to "Always," and turn on "Precise Location" and Background App Refresh.
tt.ui.faq.2.q: How do I restore an iCloud backup?
tt.ui.faq.2.a: With the same Apple ID, iCloud enabled, and a working connection, you can restore or manually sync from "iCloud Data Backup" in Settings.
tt.ui.faq.3.q: How do I completely erase my data?
tt.ui.faq.3.a: You can erase on-device data in the app's settings; if iCloud backup is enabled, delete the cloud copy as well.
trace.ui.headerSub: Route logging · Data under your control
trace.ui.privBody: No account, no built-in ads or third-party analytics. Tracks stay on your current device by default; iCloud sync is used only when you turn it on yourself.
trace.ui.desc.start: Get started quickly, from the location permission to replaying your routes.
trace.ui.desc.privacy: Learn how track data, iCloud, and system permissions are handled.
trace.ui.desc.terms: Please read the Terms of Use before using the app.
trace.ui.desc.support: Helping you record and manage every trip with ease.
trace.ui.faq.0.q: How do I adjust location permissions?
trace.ui.faq.0.a: In Settings → Privacy & Security → Location Services → TraceApp, choose "While Using the App" or "Always"; you can turn it off anytime.
trace.ui.faq.1.q: How do I delete my data?
trace.ui.faq.1.a: You can delete individual or all records within the app; uninstalling removes on-device data. If iCloud is enabled, the synced copy must be managed separately in iCloud.
trace.ui.faq.2.q: What should I provide when reporting an issue?
trace.ui.faq.2.a: We recommend including steps to reproduce, the expected and actual results, your device model, and system version; screenshots can help pinpoint the issue.
mem.ui.priv.ios: No account, no ads, no third-party tracking; if sync is enabled, it goes only to your iCloud private database.
mem.ui.priv.hm: No account, no network, no cloud backup; your records are stored only on the current device.

mem.ui.faq.0.q: Will my data sync to other devices?
mem.ui.faq.0.a.ios: Once you sign in to iCloud and enable sync, your data syncs across iPhone, iPad, and Apple Watch through your iCloud private library.
mem.ui.faq.0.a.hm: No. This version doesn't connect to the network or offer cloud sync, so data is stored only on the current device.
mem.ui.faq.1.q: How do I delete my data?
mem.ui.faq.1.a.ios: You can delete records within the app; uninstalling the app removes local data, and iCloud data can be managed in the system's Settings → iCloud.
mem.ui.faq.1.a.hm: You can delete records within the app and empty the trash; uninstalling the app removes all local data.
mem.ui.faq.2.a: Please make sure the entry has a reminder set and that the app is allowed to send notifications in system settings. Turning off notifications only affects reminders, not the records themselves.
